title: Combination padlock
prompt: how does a combination lock know the code? a dial combination padlock modelled large: turn the dial to each number, the three cams line up their notches, pull the shackle open, reset; wrong code stays locked; see-through shows the dial, spindle, three wheels with notches, fence, lever and shackle latch
blurb: Dial right, left, right and three notched wheels line up under a fence; only then can the lever slip the latch out of the shackle's notch.
